property.name: Availability Topic
property.description: Topic to subscribe for device availability (optional)

property.name: Availability Topic Value
property.description: Raw value received from the availability topic

property.name: Availability Value Path
property.description: JSONPath to extract availability value (e.g., "$.status"). Leave empty to use raw payload.

property.name: Availability Value Path Result
property.description: Result of JSONPath extraction for availability

property.name: Availability Status
property.description: Current availability status

property.name: Payload Available
property.description: Payload that indicates device is available (if only this is set, other values mean unavailable)

property.name: Payload Not Available
property.description: Payload that indicates device is not available (if only this is set, other values mean available)

property.name: Discovered Device
property.description: Pick a Tasmota shutter or Shelly cover found by the MQTT Broker; every setting below is filled in and follows the device. (Manual) leaves the settings as typed.

property.name: Device Notes
property.description: Settings on the discovered device that should change for this shutter to work well

property.name: Control
property.description: Position: open, close and move the shutter. Tilt: the slats of a venetian blind (add a second MQTT Shutter driver for them).

property.name: Capabilities
property.description: What the shutter can do with the current settings

property.name: Shutter State
property.description: State as reported to Control4

property.name: Payload Mode
property.description: Separate Topics: state and command topics per ability with plain values (Tasmota, Home Assistant MQTT cover). JSON: one state and one command topic carrying a JSON object (Zigbee2MQTT). Shelly (Gen2+): a cover output of a Shelly Plus, Pro, Gen3 or Gen4 controlled over Shelly RPC.

property.name: Shelly Topic Prefix
property.description: The Shelly's MQTT topic prefix (by default its device ID, e.g. shellyplus2pm-a8032ab12345)

property.name: Shelly Component
property.description: The cover: cover:0 (or cover:1 on devices with two)

property.name: JSON State Topic
property.description: Topic the shutter publishes its JSON state on (e.g. zigbee2mqtt/Living Blind)

property.name: JSON Command Topic
property.description: Topic to publish JSON commands to (e.g. zigbee2mqtt/Living Blind/set)

property.name: Position Key
property.description: JSON key for the position, 0-100 (e.g. position)

property.name: Tilt Key
property.description: JSON key for the slat position (e.g. tilt)

property.name: State Key
property.description: JSON key for open/close/stop commands and states (e.g. state)

property.name: Moving Key
property.description: JSON key reporting movement: UP/DOWN/STOP or opening/closing/stopped (e.g. moving)

property.name: State Request Topic
property.description: Optional: topic that makes the device report its state (Tasmota: cmnd/<topic>/ShutterPosition1 with an empty payload)

property.name: State Request Payload
property.description: Payload for the State Request Topic

property.name: Optimistic
property.description: Assume a command worked (Auto: yes when no state topic is set)

property.name: QoS
property.description: MQTT Quality of Service for commands

property.name: Retain
property.description: Retain command messages on the broker

property.name: Travel Time (Seconds)
property.description: How long a full open or close takes; used for Navigator progress and when the device does not report its position

property.name: Tilt Time (Seconds)
property.description: How long the slats take from closed to open

property.name: Invert Position
property.description: Yes when the device reports 0 as open and 100 as closed

property.name: Position State Topic
property.description: Topic reporting the position (Tasmota: stat/<topic>/RESULT)

property.name: Position Value Path
property.description: JSONPath to the position, 0-100 (Tasmota: $.Shutter1.Position)

property.name: Position Command Topic
property.description: Topic to send a position (0-100) to. Filling it in lets Control4 move the shutter to any level (Tasmota: cmnd/<topic>/ShutterPosition1)

property.name: Target Value Path
property.description: Optional: JSONPath on the position state topic to the position being moved to (Tasmota: $.Shutter1.Target)

property.name: Movement State Topic
property.description: Optional: topic reporting whether the shutter is moving (Tasmota: stat/<topic>/RESULT)

property.name: Movement Value Path
property.description: JSONPath to the movement: 1/-1/0, opening/closing/stopped or UP/DOWN/STOP (Tasmota: $.Shutter1.Direction)

property.name: Open Command Topic
property.description: Topic to open the shutter (Tasmota: cmnd/<topic>/ShutterOpen1)

property.name: Open Payload
property.description: Payload for Open (JSON mode: the State Key value, default OPEN)

property.name: Close Command Topic
property.description: Topic to close the shutter (Tasmota: cmnd/<topic>/ShutterClose1)

property.name: Close Payload
property.description: Payload for Close (JSON mode: default CLOSE)

property.name: Stop Command Topic
property.description: Topic to stop the shutter (Tasmota: cmnd/<topic>/ShutterStop1). Filling it in adds Stop.

property.name: Stop Payload
property.description: Payload for Stop (JSON mode: default STOP)

property.name: Tilt State Topic
property.description: Topic reporting the slat position (Tasmota: stat/<topic>/RESULT)

property.name: Tilt Value Path
property.description: JSONPath to the slat position (Tasmota: $.Shutter1.Tilt)

property.name: Tilt Command Topic
property.description: Topic to send a slat position to (Tasmota: cmnd/<topic>/ShutterTilt1)

property.name: Tilt Min
property.description: Device value for slats closed, shown as 0% (Tasmota: -90)

property.name: Tilt Max
property.description: Device value for slats open, shown as 100% (Tasmota: 90)

property.name: Open Button LED When Open
property.description: LED color of keypad buttons bound to the Open Button Link while the shutter is open (or partly open)

property.name: Open Button LED When Closed
property.description: LED color of keypad buttons bound to the Open Button Link while the shutter is closed

property.name: Close Button LED When Open
property.description: LED color of keypad buttons bound to the Close Button Link while the shutter is open (or partly open)

property.name: Close Button LED When Closed
property.description: LED color of keypad buttons bound to the Close Button Link while the shutter is closed

property.name: Toggle Button LED When Open
property.description: LED color of keypad buttons bound to the Toggle Button Link while the shutter is open (or partly open)

property.name: Toggle Button LED When Closed
property.description: LED color of keypad buttons bound to the Toggle Button Link while the shutter is closed
